_comment: What the phone and the Gateway both name a held bootstrap frame by: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of GATEWAY_BOOTSTRAP_PICKUP_V1, a newline, then the one-time code. `payload.text` is an enrollment code as a Gateway shows it, and `payload.pickupId` is what its code hashes to. Read by gateway-bootstrap-service.test.ts and GatewayBootstrapPickupTest.kt.
